toolDescriptions.SearchWixRESTDocumentation: Search Wix REST API docs. Use this to find endpoints for site management, data collections, stores, bookings, and more.
toolDescriptions.CallWixSiteAPI: Execute Wix API calls on a specific site. Always check docs first with SearchWixRESTDocumentation.
toolDescriptions.ListWixSites: List all Wix sites in your account. Use this to find site IDs.
